visual.general_description: Operative color photograph with one arrow marking pale looping material.
visual.detailed_description: A tall unlettered color operative photograph shows pale gloved hands holding and drawing apart exposed pink/red tissue over a blue textured drape. A narrow red tissue bridge runs toward a small pale-furred, blood-stained area at the lower center. Several fine pale thread-like loops/strands lie over the tissue and curve downward. One large solid black left-pointing arrow indicates the lower looped strands. The upper background is out of focus, showing a dark furred body surface, pale material and blurred equipment. A translucent tube curves across the upper furred/background region; its purpose is not identified from the image. No ruler, numeric scale, panel labels or acquisition metadata appear.

assignments.rationale: Exact photographic correspondence: identical gloved-finger positions, red tissue contours, blue drape folds and fine pale looping strands. Main Fig1 is a closer crop with two small arrows; supplementary TIFF is the wider scene with one larger arrow and additional upper furred body/background. This is the same photograph, not an identity inference from similar anatomy. Original case b00005 and Fig1 caption b00070 explicitly connect that photograph to the cat’s spermatic-cord finding.
